candidates.text: The agenda is established to include three presentations.
PM reports that their computer is not functioning properly.
MTD022ID reports that their screen is reduced in size.
Teletext will be skipped, as it is outdated and not required in the future.
The new product should target customers below forty instead of current customers who are forty plus.
We will build LCD screen and speech recognition for users under forty, as they are more interested, while users over forty are less interested.
Keep all classic functions but make the buttons as user-friendly as possible.
The logo has to be present and the colors fixed, and branding should not be changed significantly.
We have the option for more functions.
candidates.owner_cue: UI(MTD023UID): We have the option for more functions.

candidates.text: And we do have to integrate the screen and the speech recognition.
candidates.owner_cue: ID(MTD022ID): And we do have to integrate the screen and the the speech

candidates.text: We will remove for kids; it's only for adults, so we will use advanced options.
candidates.owner_cue: UI(MTD023UID): Um <disfmarker> ... we can remove for kids.

candidates.text: We will make the basic options very easy with one-button operation for channel zapping.
candidates.owner_cue: UI(MTD023UID): Um <disfmarker> ... one button

candidates.text: We will control only one device—the television.
candidates.owner_cue: UI(MTD023UID): Okay one device.

candidates.text: The screen will host the configuration options and advanced features, keeping basic functions on the device.
candidates.owner_cue: ME(MTD024ME): and then the basic function just on the device itself, with screen menu to do that

candidates.text: What does the screen do?
candidates.owner_cue: PM(MTD021PM): What does the screen do?

candidates.text: There is a risk that making the product fashionable could reduce its functionality; a trade-off between form and function.
candidates.owner_cue: UI(MTD023UID): ... the fashionable design risk reducing functionality; 'Content and form'

candidates.text: There is an information gap or missing content in the discussion, as indicated by 'I didn't see <gap>'.
candidates.owner_cue: UI(MTD023UID): I didn't see <gap>.

candidates.text: The group adopts the management directive: there will be no teletext, and only for T_V_.
The target user age range will be sixteen to forty.
The information on the website came too late, hindering understanding of required functions.
The actual design has not been completed; the design has not been produced yet.
ID feels slow to contribute; unsure if they are too slow for this stuff.
The physical remote prototype doesn't work well and is bent, indicating a hardware ergonomic issue.
The remote design currently lacks line control, which is a usability issue.
There is ambiguity about where to place the logo relative to the screen, requiring a design decision.
Place the display on top of the remote.
The corporate logo should be placed on the top area when the screen is placed on top.
The microphone should be mounted on the top area and be as small as possible.
There must be a display; providing a screen is essential.
We should decide what advanced options to put in the LCD screen.
Include basic sound options (treble and bass) and an equaliser on the LCD, with limited complexity.
The team proposes to implement two menus: a direct button menu and a separate LCD/software driven options menu.
candidates.owner_cue: So we need two menus kind of thing.
